title: Mont Blanc
route: Courmayeur → Pavillon du Mont Fréty → Punta Helbronner → Courmayeur
introTitle: Up into the Mont Blanc massif.
intro: One of the signature mountain days of The Long Way Around begins in Courmayeur with the Skyway Monte Bianco. The rotating cable cars climb from the valley to Pavillon du Mont Fréty before continuing high into the Mont Blanc massif to Punta Helbronner, where panoramic views stretch across some of the highest peaks in the Alps.

stops.name: Pavillon du Mont Fréty

stops.name: Punta Helbronner
stops.description: Reach the top of Skyway Monte Bianco at 3,462 meters for panoramic views across the Mont Blanc massif.

stops.name: Pavillon du Mont Fréty
stops.description: Descend through Pavillon before returning to the valley.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.description: Return to Courmayeur and settle back into the Italian Alps after a day high above the valley.
